problem: The doc-citation guard cannot see a citation that names a dot-directory, so a dead script path in AGENTS.md's own tooling table survived indefinitely. Make the guard read dot-paths, exempt the one dot-path that is untracked by owner policy, and prove both with tests.
notes: Verification-plane row, forked from features/mega-merge@e90cb0f7b in its own worktree because the main checkout holds another stream's uncommitted Python port. Root cause is one character class: CITATION requires the backticked token to start with [A-Za-z0-9_], so every .claude/ .kilo/ .commandcode/ citation is invisible. Fence widened after measuring the fix's real cost: it surfaces exactly 5 HIGH findings in 3 documents from 2 files that exist nowhere, and landing a guard that turns --strict red without reconciling them would hand the next agent a red gate.
